caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers, also known as a highboy, with an ornate and symmetrical design. The chest is composed of two main sections: an upper and a lower portion. The upper section features five small drawers stacked vertically at the center, flanked by pairs of larger drawers, and topped with a domed and scroll-shaped pediment adorned with three finials. The uppermost center drawer has a decorative motif resembling a carved shell. The lower section contains three drawers: a large central drawer with a shell motif matching the one above, and two smaller drawers on either side. The chest stands on four slender, cabriole legs that curve outward at the feet. The entire chest is rendered in shades of rich brown, imitating polished wood grain, with gold-colored handles and keyholes on the drawers. Light and shadow are used to provide a sense of depth, and fine lines indicate details such as inlay star motifs on the side panels. The drawing is presented on a light, cream-colored background with a simple rectangular border, and the artist's signature "FRANCIS BORELLI" appears at the lower right corner.
title: Highboy
